title: Isolation of SARS-Cov2 RNA from Humans Without High Demand Reagents
author: Joseph Patterson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be8ujhww
materials: Discard the supernatant, keep the pellet.

steps.title: Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Transfer the swab into a DNase/RNase free 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Pull swabs off their stick if necessary for easier processing

steps.title: Lysis
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of TRIzol to the microcentrifuge tube, close the tube, and shake by hand for 2 min.

steps.title: Swab Removal
steps.instruction: Remove the swab from the TRIzol, squeezing it against the side of the tube to retain as much sample as possible, and briefly centrifuge.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the RNA using either a Phasemaker tube or a standard microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Option A (Phasemaker): Transfer the entire sample to a Phasemaker tube (Invitrogen A33248), incubate at RT for 5 min, centrifuge for 30 s at 16,000xg, add 100 uL of 100% chloroform, shake by hand for 15 seconds (DO NOT VORTEX), incubate for 10 min at room temperature, and centrifuge for 5 min at 16,000xg at 4°C.
Option B (Standard tube): Add 100 uL of 100% chloroform, vortex for 30 s, incubate for 3 min at room temperature, and centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 10 min at 4 ºC.

steps.title: Aqueous Phase Recovery
steps.instruction: Transfer the clear aqueous phase (or supernatant if using Option B) to a new DNase/RNase free 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and dispose of the previous tube.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the RNA using isopropanol and GlycoBlue.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 20 min at 4 ºC

steps.title: RNA Wash and Drying
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet with ethanol and air dry.

substeps.instruction: Add 80% ethanol to wash the pellet
Immediately remove all ethanol (briefly centrifuge and pipette to remove remaining liquid)
Allow pellet to dry for 3 min at room temperature

steps.title: RNA Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in nuclease free water.

substeps.instruction: Use 25µL nuclease free water as a starting volume for droplet digital PCR or qPCR, though this can be adjusted if needed

steps.title: Storage
steps.instruction: If needed, samples can be frozen at -80 ºC and thawed for use when ready.
